description.value: Jak's (formerly Moonrakers Cold Beere & Wine Store) is a neighbourhood liquor retail chain with 10 locations across Greater Vancouver, carrying craft beer, wine, and premium spirits. The New Westminster store is one of ten, with in-store browsing supported by knowledgeable staff trained to make personalised recommendations. Online ordering with home delivery is also available through the JAK's website.
